policy: default-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'none'; img-src 'none'; font-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; worker-src 'none'; manifest-src 'none'; media-src 'none'; child-src 'none'

lines.text: claim#absent|text:No Content-Security-Policy response header until a human seals the exact header bytes.
claim#report-only|text:Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only is absent. Report-only is not enforcement and is not a badge.
claim#none|text:The candidate policy is default-src none. It is not a self allowlist and it is not a grant to load scripts.
claim#unsafe|text:unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval, unsafe-hashes, and strict-dynamic are denied.
claim#star|text:Star, https, data, blob, and localhost sources are denied.
claim#nonce|text:A nonce is denied. A static file cannot mint a per-response nonce.
claim#meta|text:A meta tag is not this header. frame-ancestors, report-uri, and sandbox do not apply in meta.
claim#report|text:report-uri and report-to are denied. Violation reports are not sent.
claim#ancestors|text:frame-ancestors none is in the candidate bytes only. It is not live until the header is sealed.
claim#base|text:base-uri none and object-src none are in the candidate bytes. An injected base tag is not a grant.
claim#script|text:script-src none. The preview verifier is not covered and must not be required to read the page.
claim#style|text:style-src none. Inline style on the preview is not a sealed exception.
claim#self|text:self is denied until a human names the document and the directive.
claim#tokens|text:This page does not price tokens and does not pitch Void Monthly.
